name: ai4u-a2a-connector
description: MCP server and skill that let Claude discover and talk to A2A agents registered as SAP BTP destinations, using the user's btp CLI session.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to A2A agents registered as BTP destinations.
interface.longDescription: Discovers A2A agents among the SAP BTP destinations of the subaccount targeted by the btp CLI and lets the assistant hold multi-turn conversations with them, such as the AI4U project list agent.
defaultPrompt: Which A2A agents can you reach?
Ask the project list agent which projects still need a one-pager.
